title: ischaemum burmanicum var. keralensis
intro: Ischaemum burmanicum var. keralensis, commonly known as Bristle grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Ischaemum burmanicum var. keralensis include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which provide therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving respiratory congestion, and soothing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
